QuestInfo.name: All About Professions
QuestInfo.0: Profession? Alchemy? Herbalism? What does it all mean?? Talk to #bGrant#k in #bArdentmill#k to learn about Professions.
QuestInfo.2:
You're ready to learn a Profession!


- Profession Requirements:  

Lv. 35 or above, 2nd job 

#k - The following Professions can be learned together:#r

(You can acquire all 5 in Heroic Worlds)#r

Herbalism + Alchemy + Mining
 Smithing + Mining + Herbalism 

Mining + Herbalism + Accessory Crafting

#k - Speak with the masters in #bArdentmill#k to learn their Professions.

0.0: Ah, so you want to learn about Professions? Of course, of course! I'll tell you whatever you want to know.

yes.0: Very good. Now, let me explain Professions to you...

no.0: But you're the one who came to me?\nIf you ever want to craft an item or gather rare materials, come find me. I'll set you on the right path.

1.0: This is #rArdentmill#k, where the masters of all Professions live. Masters of #bHerbalism, Mining, Smithing, Accessory Crafting, and Alchemy#k teach their craft here. Who knows what manner of Profession masters will appear in the future?
1.2:
A well rounded Professional knows 2 harvesting skills and 1 crafting skill.

#rHerbalism + Mining + Alchemy
Herbalism + Mining + Accessory Crafting
Herbalism + Mining + Smithing
#kThose are some good combinations. This way, you can supply yourself with your own crafting materials.
1.3: But you should try it for yourself! You'll learn much more quickly that way. Speak to any of the masters in town to learn more about their craft.
1.1: Of course, one person can't learn all 5 Professions. You can only learn 3. It might be a little restrictive for some people, but rules are rules.\r\n#b(You can learn all 5 in Heroic Worlds.)#k
